text:
maya: Heads up — noticed a weird pattern on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate in the canary: p95 dropped ~20ms but p99 jumped ~300ms at 14:12 UTC.
julian: saw that too. did you slice by route? could be fallback routing mixing in heavier tails.
sam: I pulled the raw samples — there's a big cluster of >2s outliers. interestingly they all have kvcache_hit=false in the telemetry payload.
maya: ah ok. so the canary change improved avg latency for cache-hits but exposed a subset of cold-paths that blow up the tail.
ria: console question — should p99 show a provenance badge (cache-hit vs gateway vs worker)? right now percentiles are merged and it's misleading.
console-team: agree — a provenance tag would help. also sample counts for each provenance bucket next to the percentile would prevent overinterpreting low-count p99s.
julian: +1. also we should stop firing SLO alerts on p99 when sample_count < N (proposal: N=100). low counts are noisy and trigger paging for nothing.
sam: quick fetch command if anyone wants raw samples: 
```
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/api/v1/samples?endpoint=/v1/generate&since=15m" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TELEMETRY" | jq '.[] | {latency_ms, provenance, route, model_variant}'
```
maya: thanks — I ran that and can confirm the outliers are mostly from route=legacy-fallback and provenance=inference-worker (cold start).
ria: UX idea: in latency panel add a small dropdown "show by provenance" that toggles merged percentiles vs split view (columns: p50/p95/p99 + sample_count per provenance). default still merged but with a tooltip: "Merged percentiles combine different sample origins; click to split."
julian: implementation notes: backend will need to support group-by provenance + sampling window. telemetry already tags provenance, but current rollup contracts compress it away. we'll need an opt-in flag for the rollup query to keep provenance dimension.
console-team: I can take the front-end work. will add a microcopy explaining sample-count requirements and a dimmed warning when p99 sample_count < 50.
sam: I'll add the flag to the query layer and a test endpoint that returns both merged and split rollups so UI can switch without extra latency.
maya: action items: ria file UX ticket, console-team pick it up, sam add rollup flag + test endpoint, julian update SLO alerting rule to include sample_count guard.
deploy-bot: canary deployed: inference-canary v2.3.1 at 14:05 UTC :rocket:
ops-bot: noted. added thread to #incidents if SLO fires.
maya: sounds good. can we also add a tiny example in docs for ops on how to interpret provenance-split percentiles? a one-paragraph help note would save time during on-call.
ria: will draft the help note in the UI PR.
julian: risk: if we split too many dimensions the dashboard blows up. keep default merge but provide a clear path to drill down.
maya: agreed — keep defaults simple. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
